project.name: acorn-weather-sdk
project.summary: A curated client-library miniature with explicit public contracts.
project.thesis: A public client surface translates caller options into a transport boundary and typed results.

nodes.label: Client Method
nodes.description: Exposes WeatherClient.forecast as the public SDK method available to callers.
nodes.why_it_matters: It is the API surface a user chooses first.
nodes.inspector_summary: Public method documented and implemented in the client module.

nodes.label: Request Options
nodes.description: Defines city and units as typed caller inputs to the forecast request surface.
nodes.why_it_matters: It names what callers can configure without exposing transport details.
nodes.inspector_summary: Caller-owned options are represented as a frozen data contract.

nodes.label: HTTP Transport
nodes.description: Separates public SDK calls from the service communication implementation.
nodes.inspector_summary: The transport is a boundary, not a recorded request trace.

nodes.label: Typed Response
nodes.description: Defines the stable forecast value returned through the public client contract.
nodes.inspector_summary: The typed model is the caller-facing result shape.

workflows.label: Client Contract Reading
workflows.description: Read the SDK surfaces a caller must understand without claiming observed execution.

decision_record.repository_thesis_summary: A public client surface translates caller options into a transport boundary and typed results.

projection_candidates.label: Client Contract
projection_candidates.question_answered: Which public surfaces and data contracts matter to callers?
distortion_risks: It does not demonstrate a live network exchange.
projection_candidates.selection_reason: The source and documentation expose a caller-oriented contract.

projection_candidates.label: Request Trace
projection_candidates.question_answered: What happens during one remote call?
distortion_risks: No recorded remote call exists in this miniature.
projection_candidates.selection_reason: A runtime trace would overclaim the available evidence.

scenario_candidates.label: Public Surface Reading
scenario_candidates.reason: A structural tour teaches the contract without claiming runtime.

over_centralization_risks.risk: Transport detail could appear to be the public product.
over_centralization_risks.mitigation: Keep the public client method as the first landmark.

relation_families.label: Read Along Contract
relation_families.description: Connects caller-facing surfaces without runtime assertion.

projections.label: Client Contract
projections.description: A public SDK reading centered on stable caller-facing surfaces.
projections.question_answered: Which public surfaces and data contracts matter to callers?

scenarios.label: Public Surface Reading
scenarios.description: Inspect a caller-oriented API contract without implying a captured request.

steps.title: Choose A Method
steps.narration: Begin with the public method that a caller can select.

steps.title: Read Options
steps.narration: Read the typed options as caller-owned configuration.

steps.title: Inspect Boundary
steps.narration: Inspect the transport boundary described behind the public API.

steps.title: Read Result Shape
steps.narration: Finish with the typed value made visible to callers.
